coordinates.object_orientation: Head -Y, tail +Y, up +Z; neutral extended swimming pose.
coordinates.mount: Suspended swimming mount at trunk core (0,0,0), no floor contact

concept.reason: Actual published skeleton image available; no extra concept.

scope: Original whole organism: narrow toothless snout and stiff armoured back. Not a whale, isolated skull or Parahupehsuchus body tube.
specimen_basis: 2020-NYF-84-4 nearly complete skeleton in Fang2023 Fig1A; WGSC V26007 skull/anterior skeleton in Fig1B. Primary specimen comparison, not copying author living illustration.

scale.basis: Chen et al.2014 discussion places Hupehsuchus around1m. Genus-level reconstruction target, not measured length of2020-NYF-84-4.

diagnostic_targets: Long narrow flattened toothless snout on modest head and distinct neck; no broad duckbill or huge whale head.
Stiff elongate robust trunk with low layered dorsal ossicle ridge; no stegosaur plates, sail or turtle shell.
Four paddlelike limbs, fore pair larger, long tapering laterally compressed tail.
Neutral closed-mouth pose, no baleen curtain, expanded throat sac or definitive filter-feeding behavior.
uncertainties: 2023 filter-feeding inference is challenged by2025 PeerJ19666; preserve uncertainty, no invented whale soft tissues.
Colour, skin, exact flesh depth and paddle outline inferred. Fossil compression not living body thickness; distal tail outline reconstructed, not fully shown in figure.
Do not substitute related short-necked Eohupehsuchus proportions or Parahupehsuchus extreme bony body tube.
acceptance_checks: Narrow elongated toothless snout and stiff low armoured dorsal profile read in four views.
Four connected paddles with clear negative spaces and tail taper.
No giant dorsal fin, whale fluke, baleen or inflated throat.
Armour low and continuous rather than floating spikes.
handoff_contract: Same localdir prep/maker/QA, maker COMPLETE with fixedhash then stops. Root async backup; retain local for integration. No maker upload or cleanup.
material_profile: Six opaque palette-only PBR materials; muted grey-brown countershading, original artistic reconstruction
